title: Characterization of highly selective microporous carbon hollow fiber membranes prepared from a commercial co-polyimide precursor
material_description: (unlabelled 1) | carbon molecular sieve hollow fiber membrane made by pyrolysis of commercial P84 (BTDA-TDI/MDI) co-polyimide asymmetric hollow fibers in flowing N2 to 1173 K (5 K/min, 5 min hold)
source_location: main.txt p. 629 (PDF page 5), Fig. 6 (low pressure H2 adsorption/desorption at 77 K), adsorption (filled diamonds) series
notes: digitized: P = 4.505 mbar (printed unit mbar, stored /1000 as bar), 1.497 mmol/g (printed unit; wt% computed as W1 = 0.201588 x mmol/g); archive: HYC-0129_fig6_adsorption.json. Degas overnight at 573 K (duration not numeric), about 1e-7 mbar. Autosorb-1 (Quantachrome, with Krypton upgrade). Isotherm_point_count is a lower bound: 65 markers resolved; a stack of overlapping adsorption markers below about 12 mbar and 2.3 mmol/g could not be separated. Marker overlapped by neighbouring markers or partly hidden behind an open desorption marker; position from template fit, lower confidence.
